newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Neves Corvo can assure one week supply.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Neves Corvo can assure one week supply.

text.p: Portugal's strike-hit copper mine at Neves Corvo has stocks to supply customers for one more week, providing it is able to get a shipment moved from the mine to port, personnel director Raul Araujo told Reuters.

He said the company would start sending out letters to customers on Monday warning them that it might not be able to stick to delivery schedules if a strike at the 107,000 tonne per year mine were not settled over the weekend.
Araujo said there was one shipment, some 700 tonnes of concentrate, at the port of Setubal and another ready to go at the mine, 250 kms south of Lisbon.
"On Monday, we are going to have to alert clients of possible difficulties (in supply)," he said.
Unions and management were meeting government officials in nearby Beja later on Friday in a further attempt to break the deadlock over working hours which has paralysed the mine since Monday.
